correctness.rationale: The directed chain has stationary motility correlation (1/2)e^{-r|t|}cos(rt). The Green-filter ODE gives the exact displayed covariance and its h=1 limit. For 0<h<1 the normalized sign is A+B e^{-(1−h)u}cos(u−φ), with one trough in each negative cosine sector. Strict inequalities at troughs give N=ceil[log(M/A)/(2π(1−h))], with tangencies excluded. A positive Laplace-kernel convolution nesting gives uniqueness of h*=0.8914223658803029… and nonnegativity at equality. Oscillatory dominance proves infinite bands for h≥1 and N~log5/[4π(1−h)] near 1. Independently solved 8-dimensional generator/mixed-moment ODE and checked exact formula at 64 (h,u) pairs; checked onset and lobe counts. Finite checks do not replace the analysis.
